subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own an unsigned iOS `.xcarchive` workflow after the dispatch-input and token-hardening defects are repaired?
rationale: The code defects are mechanically repairable, but accepting a new downloadable mobile build artifact path and macOS CI surface is a maintainer security/operations decision.

options.title: Harden And Re-review For Merge
options.body: Repair input validation and token handling first, rerun the workflow for fresh artifact proof, then let maintainers decide whether the lane belongs in core.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Leave the contributor's fork workflow as an external experiment if OpenClaw does not want to own unsigned iOS artifact automation.

options.title: Accept Current Infra Risk
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept the current workflow shape, but that would leave avoidable shell-input and credential-scope risk in repository automation.

recommendation.title: Harden And Re-review For Merge
recommendation.body: Repair input validation and token handling first, rerun the workflow for fresh artifact proof, then let maintainers decide whether the lane belongs in core.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily CI/security-boundary ownership, and history links `vincentkoc` to recent workflow hardening.
